## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

- [ ] Test file tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py exists
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py

- [ ] test_proximity_cited_lines_suppress_overlap exists in test file
  Verify: grep -q 'test_proximity_cited_lines_suppress_overlap' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py

- [ ] test_proximity_cited_lines_no_suppress_outside_window exists
  Verify: grep -q 'test_proximity_cited_lines_no_suppress_outside_window' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py

- [ ] test_legacy_fallback_description_prefix_when_no_cited_lines exists
  Verify: grep -q 'test_legacy_fallback_description_prefix_when_no_cited_lines' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py

- [ ] All new tests fail (RED) when run against current codebase (before T4 implementation)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_proximity.py -x 2>&1 | grep -E 'FAILED|ERROR|failed' | head -5

- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for runner.py proximity function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_suppress_proximity\|test_proximity_cited_lines' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
